text: {"lessons":["After selling Stock B and Stock D at gains, I bought them back at higher prices; I should avoid treating a realized gain as proof I timed the sale well or chasing a stock back in.","My account value moved substantially while I mostly made no trades, so I should keep portfolio risk and diversification in view rather than judge decisions by a few monthly changes.","Because I check my account infrequently and prices are unpredictable, I should set clear reasons for buying, holding, or selling and review them deliberately instead of letting loss aversion or the pleasure of taking gains steer me."]}
